registry_binding.qualification: Native M-CSA reaction-associated reference catalytic residues, joined to frozen UniProt FASTA and checked for exact amino-acid identity at every labeled position. Reaction representation retains ChEBI/name/stoichiometry participants, not invented SMILES. Binary zeros are unannotated residues, not experimentally proven nonfunctional sites. Only reference annotations retained; homology-transferred labels excluded. Derived partitions close native-entry and exact-sequence connected components; they remain development-exposed, not a new independent homology holdout. Previously inspected M-CSA data overlap the existing mechanism companion.
registry_binding.reference_evidence: Direct M-CSA reference catalytic-residue annotations and separately licensed UniProt sequence; no EasIFA annotations or code required.
